Shelter dog day-out programs in the U.S.: November 2026 report

How many animal shelters let the public take a dog out for the day, a hike or a sleepover? Here are the exact counts from our national directory, refreshed every month.

Key numbers

  • 3,898 animal shelters, humane societies and SPCAs listed
  • 551 day-out, field trip, sleepover or hiking programs found (14.14% of shelters listed)
  • Programs found in 50 of 51 jurisdictions (the 50 states plus D.C.)
  • 157 programs that include cats

Programs by status

  • 288 open to public
  • 90 volunteers only
  • 167 needs check
  • 6 paused

"Needs check" means we found a program but couldn't confirm it's still running on the shelter's website this month.

Programs by type

  • 435 day trips and outings (78.95% of programs)
  • 166 sleepovers and short-term fosters (30.13% of programs)
  • 36 hikes, walks and runs (6.53% of programs)
  • 63 visits, lounges and cafés (11.43% of programs)

Many programs offer more than one kind of outing, so these add up to more than the total.

How we count

We build the directory from shelters' own websites and public government pages, and re-check listings every month. A shelter counts as having a program when its own site describes a day-out, field trip, sleepover, hiking or similar outing program. Shelters we haven't found a program for are still listed, and visitors can ask them to start one. New this month? See new programs.
